panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Clinical photograph of thigh showing erythematous nodule with central crusting, consistent with CANDLE syndrome skin manifestation described in caption as 'nodules on the extremities'. B: Clinical photograph showing classic violaceous periorbital edema (monocle-like facies) in a child with CANDLE syndrome.
